title: Samurai Sabre
body:
Syntax: samurai sabre | samurai sabre (again to turn off)

Bukijutsu level 35. Wield a sword and activate the chakra edge to deal +5% damage with ordinary sword strikes. The original technique costs 35 Chakra and 10 Stamina to activate, and 4 Chakra per idle upkeep or 6 Chakra and 2 Stamina each combat round. It ends if the sword is removed or resources run out.

Passive mastery upgrades unlock automatically by LEVEL (no scroll and no separate command or training):
  Samurai Sabre 2 - Level 85: +5% (10% total)
  Samurai Sabre 3 - Level 140: +5% (15% total)
  Samurai Sabre 4 - Level 195: +5% (20% total)
  Samurai Sabre 5 - Level 250: +5% (25% total)

The passives only increase damage while the original Samurai Sabre toggle is ON and a sword is equipped. Costs and upkeep do not change. Bonuses stack multiplicatively with eligible Chakra Steel elemental weapon enchantments (+50%); Samurai Sabre does not activate on kunai, polearms or other non-swords. Use SKILLS or PRAC to see unlocked tiers; EXAMINE to inspect any weapon enchantment.
